title: Scoreboard
description: A simple team scoreboard for any paper, board or speaking activity: +1 / -1 per team.

title: Tag-Team Talk
description: Relay talk at M.1, M.2 and M.3: one team at the front takes turns on a topic, TAG! at each chime. Topic spinner, huddle and turn timer, speaking-order lane with your teams, +3 Win / +1 Challenge scoring.

title: Tag-Team Debate
description: FOR vs AGAINST team debate at M.1, M.2 and M.3: speakers take turns, answer the last point, then add a new one. Motion spinner, huddle and turn timer, speaking-order lane, +3 Win / +1 Challenge scoring.

title: Word Rush
description: Teams write as many words as they can for a prompt before the timer ends. Bonus cards change the scoring each round. Prompts for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Think Tank Showdown
description: Critical-thinking game show: Riddle Rush, Spot the Problem, What Would Happen If…?, Final Wager. Questions for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Talk Timer
description: Big classroom timer. Presets with one or more phases (for example 1:00 talk + 0:10 change over), a chime at zero. Edit your own presets.

title: Name Picker
description: A tool: picks a random present student. Nobody is picked twice until everyone has had a turn (remembered for the day). Points only if you turn them on.

title: Sentence Scramble Race
description: A sentence appears as shuffled word tiles. Teams write it correctly on paper. First three correct teams get 3 / 2 / 1 points, then Reveal.

title: Quiz Battle
description: One question at a time with a timer (multiple choice or short answer). Teams hold up answers; tap the teams that were right. Built-in sets, or your own from the Questions tab of your Sheet.

title: Board Race
description: A task appears (verb forms, a category, idioms). Teams line up at the whiteboard: one student writes one answer, then passes the pen to the next. You tap points per team.

title: Hot Seat Vocab
description: One student per team faces away from the board. Teammates describe the word without saying it. 60-second rounds, Got it (+1) or Skip. M.3 uses Person / Place / Thing / Idea.

title: 20 Questions
description: You think of a person, place, thing or idea; the class shows only the category. Teams (or the whole class) ask yes/no questions, with a countdown of questions left. The winner gets a point for each question left.

title: Class Order
description: A tool: go down the class list (by number or in a random order). Shows who is now and who is on deck; absent students keep their place. Remembers where you stopped for next lesson.

title: Dice & Spinner
description: Roll 1-3 dice, or spin a wheel with your own options (numbers, teams, topics, rewards). Don't-repeat option.

title: Noise Light
description: A full-screen traffic light for noise: tap green / yellow / red, or let the microphone measure how loud the class is.

title: Would You Rather?
description: Two choices on the board. Each team picks one and gives a reason ("I'd rather ... because ..."). Points for good reasons and linking words.

title: Just a Minute
description: One student talks on a topic until the timer ends: no long stops, no repeats. The other teams listen and challenge. Reveal shows three ideas to help.

title: Sentence Builder
description: Three word cards. Teams write one correct sentence that uses all three words. Reveal shows an example sentence.

title: Category Grid
description: A letter and five categories (Animals, Food, Jobs...). Teams write a word for each before the timer ends. Words no other team has score extra.

title: Story Order
description: The five sentences of a short story are mixed up (A-E). Teams write the right order. Reveal shows it.

title: Read & Remember
description: Teams read a short story against the timer. Then the story hides and three questions appear. Answers come last.

title: True or False Race
description: A short story stays on the board. One sentence at a time: teams race to show True or False. Four sentences per story.

title: Spot the Mistakes
description: A short story with three mistakes (verb forms, grammar). Teams find and fix them. Reveal shows wrong → right.

title: Scan It!
description: A real-world text (menu, bus or train schedule, poster, weather, opening hours, sale ad, league table, movie times) and three questions. Teams scan fast for the answers; M.3 needs a little math.
